title: Fix Definition IDs Using Absolute Paths in Hook Events
description: The id system is not properly setup. e.g. when copying the id in the vscode extension it is missing the starting emoji which is part of the id. Find all mismatchtes, fix them and extend the tests, so this cant happen in the future.
summary: Fixed buildDefinitionReads to produce repo-relative definition IDs. Root cause: when Windsurf sends pre_read_code with absolute tool_info.file_path, the filesToLines map keys were absolute paths (e.g. /workspaces/semio/repo/server/main.go). ParseDefinitions was called with these absolute paths, causing Definition.FilePath to be absolute, which made GetID() produce IDs like 🛅️🗃️workspaces🗃️compose🗃️composerepo🗃️server💻️main✂️breach instead of repo-relative IDs. Fix: use normalizeHookPath(filePath) as the path for ParseDefinitions while using the original/absolute path for os.ReadFile. Added TestBuildDefinitionReadsUsesRepoRelativePaths and TestRunHookPreReadCodeDefinitionIDsAreRepoRelative to guard against regressions.
